title: Rediscovery of RC-10 in the deliberate public buy: stx.wait() with no timeout runs inside the per-wallet nonce lock

evidence.note: withNonceLock(... async () => { stx = await router.swap...; const rec = await stx.wait(); ... })
wait() defaults its timeout to 0, which arms no timer and waits forever
a status-0 receipt makes wait() throw CALL_EXCEPTION, so a revert leaves executeDeliberateBuy by a throw (no record, which is correct: no tokens)
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): A dropped public buy can hold the wallet nonce lock indefinitely

sibling_sites_checked: The only wait( in the slice is bot.ts:750 (C09 search). The snipe submits go through sendTxWithRetry/strategies (TX slice, owner of RC-10). The deliberate private leg runs escalatePrivateBuy under the lock (:558), which is the TX slice's reconcile machinery.
severity_rationale: S1, equal to the research suggestion for RC-10 and to the pre-phase escalation ESC-PRE-02, which names this exact site (src/bot.ts:750, lock taken at :746) as one of its three: if the public tx is never mined (dropped or underpriced), wait() never returns, the nonce lock is never released, and every later same-wallet submit (sells, anti-rug exits) in that process blocks behind it. Registered from the BUY slice because the site is in this slice; it is a rediscovery, so it links the existing record through resolved_items and is not escalated again (PROTOCOL rediscovery rule). The TX slice (22-20) owns RC-10 and its other two sites (exitEngine.ts:545, :556); 22-28 merges the entries (one becomes duplicate_of the other).
recommendation: Covered by the RC-10 fix (bounded wait or no wait inside the lock) planned for Phase 24 in the TX slice; apply it to this site too.

triage.note: Reproduced on the real path (plan 23-09, AC-11, AC-12) in the RC-10 file AUD-TX-002.test.ts: a real ETH V2 deliberate buy whose two private attempts are not included clears its guard and sends the public swap inside withNonceLock, then awaits stx.wait() with no timeout; the node never mines it (valid null receipt) while 150 blocks are mined, and a later operation for the same wallet through the real lock does not start within the 30-minute fake-time window (claim deliberate-public-wait-holds-wallet-lock; bounded observation). Control: mined with three confirmations, the lock is freed, the later operation starts and the buy completes. A wait with a timeout reads looks fixed.
